subject: MAP: BeaconPilot dataset transfer & constrained-use timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sengupta <priya@beacon.ai>, Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@beacon.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: BeaconPilot dataset transfer & constrained-use timeline

Hi Priya / Ethan —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP-BeaconPilot-v1.docx) that lays out how Redwood will provision the evaluation materials (prompt pack + testcases) and the close timeline we propose. High level:

- Deliverables: prompt pack (beacon_eval_promptpack_v1.zip), usage manifest (usage_manifest.csv).
- Delivery milestone: Redwood delivers artifacts to Beacon sandbox on 2025-07-06 (SFTP link + ephemeral pre-signed tokens).
- Onboarding: engineering sandbox access and test-run walkthrough scheduled 2025-07-08.
- Acceptance gate: mutual verification window 2025-07-18 to 2025-07-22 (Beacon runs acceptance suite; Redwood supports fixes).
- Takedown: material and copies removed from Beacon-managed environments by 2025-07-29.

Constrained-use requirements we need agreed up front (summarized in the MAP doc):
- No redistribution of raw prompt/testcase data outside Beacon internal evaluation team.
- No model fine-tuning or rehosting of raw assets.
- Retention: artifacts may remain in the Beacon sandbox for a max of 30 days; logs and audit evidence to be shared per the manifest.
- Access: ephemeral tokens limited to 3 named engineers; IP allowlist required.

Please confirm these checkpoints and the acceptance window, or flag changes. Once you confirm, I’ll send the HubSpot milestone update and a DocuSign for the MAP addendum (simple one-page usage covenant).

Attachments: MAP-BeaconPilot-v1.docx (MAP summary), beacon_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (prompt pack stub), usage_manifest.csv (file-level manifest + sample checksum).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@beacon.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sengupta <priya@beacon.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: BeaconPilot dataset transfer & constrained-use timeline

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick items from our side:

1) Acceptance window: can we tighten the acceptance gate to close on 2025-07-18 instead of the 22nd? We have a stakeholder demo the week of the 21st and a shorter window helps (we'll prioritize).
2) Encryption / handling: will the files be delivered encrypted at rest and in transit (SFTP or pre-signed HTTPS OK)? Our legal team will want to confirm key rotation and evidence of deletion after takedown. I’ve looped legal@beacon.ai.
3) Sampling: can you provide a small sample subset (5–10 cases) ahead of the full delivery so our QA can sanity-check format?

If those are OK, I can confirm and we can proceed with the DocuSign addendum.

—Ethan
Ethan Shaw
Head of ML Engineering — Beacon AI
ethan.shaw@beacon.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sengupta <priya@beacon.ai>, Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@beacon.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jul 2025 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP: BeaconPilot dataset transfer & constrained-use timeline (technical notes)

Karthik / team — adding technical details for Beacon’s questions and to reduce back-and-forth during onboarding: 

- Delivery: we will upload the prompt pack to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket and share a pre-signed URL with a 72-hour window. Files are encrypted with AES-256 at rest; transfer over HTTPS. We can also provide SFTP if required.
- Sampling: attaching a small sample subset (first_10_samples.jsonl) inside the promptpack zip; checksum in usage_manifest.csv.
- Access controls: ephemeral API tokens scoped to file download + sandbox ingestion; tokens auto-expire after 14 days unless extended by mutual agreement. We will enforce IP allowlist rules; please provide the CIDR blocks.
- Audit & deletion: on takedown date (2025-07-29) Redwood will produce a deletion report (MD5 checksums, deletion timestamps) and push to the shared drive link. Beacon must acknowledge receipt of that report.

I’m attaching the updated usage_manifest.csv which enumerates filenames, checksums, and suggested handling flags. Ben (SE) will do the walkthrough on 2025-07-08.

Attachments referenced: usage_manifest.csv, beacon_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (contains sample subset first_10_samples.jsonl).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
From: Priya Sengupta <priya@beacon.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@beacon.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, legal@beacon.ai
Date: Sun, 6 Jul 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: BeaconPilot dataset transfer & constrained-use timeline

Thanks — we’re good to proceed with the proposed approach with two small edits which I think are acceptable to Redwood: 

1) Acceptance: we confirm the acceptance gate closes on 2025-07-18 (Beacon will run the acceptance suite that morning; Redwood to standby for quick fixes the afternoon of the 17th).
2) Access: we will name three engineers who get the ephemeral tokens and agree to the 30‑day retention; we also request that logs (access and deletion report) be exported to our S3 bucket for audit.

Legal is okay with the one‑page MAP addendum but prefers DocuSign rather than in-thread signatures. I’ve signed the initial HubSpot milestone comment and will approve the DocuSign when I receive it.

For the sample subset: please send the first_10_samples.jsonl by EOD Monday (2025-07-07) so our QA can start format checks.

Forwarding this to our procurement lead for visibility.

—Priya
Priya Sengupta
VP Product — Beacon AI
priya@beacon.ai
